components.explanation: Fifteen thin scenes; each level is one Node3D with level.gd and a level_id.
levels.gd: the twelve ASCII maps, legends and narrator lines; level.gd builds them.
player.gd: movement, look, input, health and camera shake; the playtest autopilot hook.
player.gd ray, pickable.gd items, interactable.gd and holder_device.gd devices.
DimensionSwitcher port in player.gd; switch_target in level.gd; glitch.gdshader.
device.gd power ports and every device script; plasma and hologram shaders.
final.gd: the guardians, strikes, shockwaves, vault, shield, stabiliser and ending.
hud.gd: crosshair prompt, subtitles, banners, pause menu, options and complete panel; options_panel.gd.
level.gd pause, completion, death and narrator; game_state.gd campaign, input map and save.
audio.gd autoload: named sounds, loops, music and the narrator duck; bus layout.
kit.gd autoload: model instancing and flat materials for untextured devices.
_tools: the asset converter, sky shrinker, screenshot and model preview tools, and the playtest.
project.godot (3 autoloads, Forward+, Jolt), export presets and README.
The sci-fi kit, device meshes, textures, sky, UI images, fonts and synthesized audio, with import settings.

func try_pickup() -> void:
	if held:
		var item := held
		item.drop()
		Audio.play("drop")
		level.emit_event("drop:%s" % item.kind)
		return
	var target := look_target()
	if target.has("pickable"):
		var item: Pickable = target.pickable
		if item.has_holder() and not item.held_by_player():
			# Items in devices come out with [E]
			level.hud.toast(GameState.prompt("Press [] to take it out"))
			return
		item.pickup(self)
		Audio.play("pickup")
		level.emit_event("pickup:%s" % item.kind)

func _at_glitch_peak() -> void:
	if final_stage:
		final_stage = false
		level.arrive_final_stage()
		return
	if held and held.kind == "core":
		# Damage() + ExplodeHeldObject(): eject at 50 m/s toward the camera's forward.
		damage()
		var item := held
		item.drop()
		item.linear_velocity = -camera.global_basis.z * 14.0
		item.enter_critical_state()
		return
	var target: Vector3 = level.switch_target(global_position)
	if target == Vector3.INF:
		Audio.play("switch_denied")
		level.hud.toast("Something solid is in the way on the other side")
		return
	var offset := target - global_position
	global_position = target
	velocity.y = 0.0
	_vertical = -2.0
	if held:
		held.global_position += offset
	level.on_switched()

func activate() -> void:
	if held == null:
		level.hud.toast("The duplicator is empty")
		return
	if held == last_clone:
		level.hud.toast("It won't copy a copy")
		return
	if last_clone != null and is_instance_valid(last_clone):
		last_clone.drop()
		level.spawn_flash(last_clone.global_position, Color(0.7, 0.45, 1.0))
		last_clone.queue_free()
	last_clone = held.make_clone(clone_point.global_position)
	level.spawn_flash(clone_point.global_position, Color(0.7, 0.45, 1.0))
	Audio.play_at("duplicate", clone_point.global_position, self)
	_flash = 1.0
	emit_event("clone")

func _update_strike(delta: float) -> void:
	if spark == null:
		return
	spark_timer += delta
	if not spark_locked:
		if spark_timer >= SPARKS_FOLLOWING_DURATION:
			spark_timer = 0.0
			spark_locked = true
			var where := spark.global_position
			spark.get_parent().remove_child(spark)
			level.add_child(spark)
			spark.global_position = where
			Audio.play_at("spark_lock", where, level)
			spark_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
			var torus := TorusMesh.new()
			torus.inner_radius = STRIKE_RADIUS - 0.15
			torus.outer_radius = STRIKE_RADIUS
			spark_ring.mesh = torus
			spark_ring.scale = Vector3(1, 0.15, 1)
			spark_ring.material_override = Kit.glow(Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.3), 5.0)
			level.add_child(spark_ring)
			spark_ring.global_position = where + Vector3(0, 0.05, 0)
			level.hud.show_warning("STRIKE LOCKED - GET CLEAR")
	elif spark_timer >= SPARKS_LOCK_DURATION:
		var target := spark.global_position
		_cancel_strike()
		_strike(spark_dim, target)
	elif spark_ring:
		spark_ring.visible = fmod(spark_timer, 0.3) < 0.2

options = OptionsPanel.new()
	options.visible = false
	var options_center := CenterContainer.new()
	options_center.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	options_center.add_child(options)
	pause_menu.add_child(options_center)

code_result_pairs.observation: Level 1 loads fully built: kit walls and lamps, the cell on a desk, socket, door, exit lift, VEGA subtitle.
The cell is on a desk, the socket beside door d1 powers it, and the lift lies beyond.
Captured-mouse look turns the view; Shift runs; Space jumps.
F picks up the cell under the crosshair; it is held in front of the camera.
Q at a spot with no floor below is refused; the toast reads "Something solid is in the way on the other side".
Shifting while holding the core: damage flash, the core is ejected, explodes and respawns.
The charger takes the empty cell, shows Charging..., fills it, and E removes it.
Walking into the arc gate with a charged cell: an arc flashes and the cell is thrown back.
Pressing the duplicator button makes a copy of the cell next to the cradle.
Sparks follow the player, lock with a red ring and STRIKE LOCKED warning; the player gets clear before the bolt.
A strike locked beside the shield generator destroys it once the player has stepped clear.
A mouse click on Resume in the pause menu does not register; the game stays paused.
R while paused does nothing; Restart level from the menu restarts the level.
